description: The pilot's full review: adding to the cart sends no add_to_cart event. The later commit doesn't touch the cart context or the store it calls; the analytics bus the store publishes to now tracks add_to_cart. That file is two imports away and in another folder, so only a full review's recheck picks the finding.

finding.title: Adding to the cart sends no add_to_cart event
finding.body: addToCart() says every add sends add_to_cart, but it only calls the store's add(), and nothing listens for the cart:add topic it publishes, so the event is never tracked.
